mainEntity.name: What happens during an on-site condensation assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: During the site visit, an inspector checks the condition of the existing vapor barrier, roof and wall insulation thickness, ridge vents, louvers, and building seals. They also evaluate how the interior space is utilized, looking for moisture sources like unvented heaters or vehicle wash bays. After gathering field observations, the contractor outlines practical remediation paths, which might range from sealing air bypasses and improving cross-ventilation to retrofitting continuous insulation.
acceptedAnswer.description: An inspector examines vapor barriers, insulation, ventilation openings, and heat sources, then provides a targeted plan to control moisture and prevent structural rust.
